title: The Horse and the Stag
summary: A wild horse had a bitter feud with a stag over grazing territory. Desiring revenge, the horse asked a man to help him hunt down the stag....
full_text:
A wild horse had a bitter feud with a stag over grazing territory. Desiring revenge, the horse asked a man to help him hunt down the stag.

The man agreed on one condition: the horse must accept an iron bit in his mouth and a leather saddle on his back.

With the man on his back, the horse easily ran down and killed the stag. But when the horse asked to be set free, the man laughed, hitched him to a stable post, and rode him as a beast of burden for the rest of his days.
moral: He who sells his liberty to avenge an insult becomes a perpetual slave.
